newsitem.title: USA: Columbia says Va. gas line back late Tues.
newsitem.headline: Columbia says Va. gas line back late Tues.

text.p: Columbia Gas Transmission Corp's service on its 30-inch diameter natural gas line through northern Virginia was restored late Tuesday, the company said Wednesday.
"It was back to normal operations at 7:30 p.m. (1930 EDT)," a company spokesman said.
Service was halted early Tuesday when a leak was discovered on the line, which was flowing 350 million cubic feet per day.
The leak occurred on the VC1 pipeline section running from CGT's compression station in Loudoun County, Va.
Columbia Gas Transmission is a subsidiary of The Columbia Gas System Inc.
